programme.desc: 沖繩集訓的相關費用必須各自靠打工賺。但伊織和耕平的日薪工收入卻都拿去喝酒花光了。而壽倒是很認真在打工,而且竟然還是當酒保。伊織和耕平對壽在店裡展現出與平時截然不同的氛圍感到困惑。之後在店長的好意下,兩人也決定嘗試體驗酒保的工作。然而,這兩個笨蛋對雞尾酒的做法當然是一竅不通,還接二連三地調出了許多危險的酒精炸彈……。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #9
programme.desc: 為了友情(金錢),伊織再次背負起安排聯誼的任務。他打算拿「國王遊戲」當藉口請千紗介紹她的朋友。隨著奈奈華和梓也被捲入遊戲中,一場各懷鬼胎的攻防戰就這麼開始了。不惜這麼做也想要錢的伊織目前似乎仍未存夠集訓的費用。但他還是得湊齊潛水必要的用品,於是他為了購買器材前往潛水用品店。對伊織這些新手來說,潛水的世界還有太多他們不了解的事了。

programme.title: 一步一腳印 發現新台灣

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛……助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:愛是有『原』 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:你的時間用在那裡? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:你的時間用在那裡? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 專題講座:張路加牧師宣教培靈系列
programme.desc: 華人福音工作是現今最大的禾場,我們需要怎樣的裝備,將福音的種子帶到華人當中?就讓擁有豐富牧會經驗的張路加牧師,教大家好好裝備,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽

programme.title: 劉三論今-十項全能的家系列
programme.desc: 羅馬書12:13 說:「聖徒缺乏,要幫補。」你覺得這也適用於你的家庭嗎?為什麼? 創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 在舊約中沒有「教會」二字,但歌羅西書1 章24至27節就提到基督的身體是教會,怎樣才是教會?怎樣的教會才是合神心意?讓吳宣倫博士從《聖經》中揭開這歷世歷代所隱藏的奧秘。

programme.title: 創世電視復興祭壇
programme.desc: 與影音使團創世電視成為一家人,一起在「創世電視復興祭壇」,以禱告和敬拜守望香港。

programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛……助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:你的時間用在那裡? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 堅穩的根基
programme.desc: 在我們生活中,有恩典並不代表沒有困難,反而困難越大越多,恩典就越大越多。基督、保羅、彼得,歷世歷代的基督工人都有困難,更有恩典夠用。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 吳宣倫博士-教會的奧秘
programme.desc: 在舊約中沒有「教會」二字,但歌羅西書1 章24至27節就提到基督的身體是教會,怎樣才是教會?怎樣的教會才是合神心意?讓吳宣倫博士從《聖經》中揭開這歷世歷代所隱藏的奧秘。

programme.desc: 脆肉鯇與草鯇雖屬相同品種，但因飼養方式不同，肉質、口感大有區別！鼎爺選購優質脆肉鯇，分別帶來「脆鯇炒蘭度」與「金針雲耳蒸脆鯇腩」。阿譚大讚炒出來的脆鯇片媲美斑球，有何烹調要訣？鼎爺還買來名貴的墨西哥遼參與寶石參，再以新鮮花蟹拆肉，及用老雞、金華火腿熬湯，巧製「雙參蟹肉羹」。他期間把滑豆腐切絲，精湛刀藝「無得輸」！阿譚以傳統中式甜品「焗西米布甸」孝敬拍檔。這款以蓮蓉作餡料的甜品，外香內軟，口感一流！

programme.title: 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 電競運動熱潮席捲全球！戴祖儀、曾展望、葉蒨文、林俊其、吳俊峰、曾文心、吳文懿等「電競星團」成員，聯同電競界知名評述「老星」主持的前奏節目《英雄召集：點解電競係電競》，會輕鬆有趣地分享相關知識與資訊，讓觀眾做好準備，迎接即將陸續上演的精彩電競賽事！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 寒冷會刺激血管收縮，引致血壓上升，血液亦較易凝固，提高心臟病發的風險。心臟科醫生補充，冬季還有不少外來病菌，為心臟病患者增加健康風險，他們外遊時有甚麼要留意？著名畫家林天行為繪出香港夜景，花長時間探索，終透過水墨重彩將香港夜之美畫出，他會親自細說幾幅作品的特色。嘉賓亦憶述西藏之旅病重期間受啟發，創作西藏系列的深刻經歷。「睇餸食飯」，闊別多時的黃亞保示範「蟲草花爆炒海蜇」，爽脆鮮甜兼有鑊氣。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 三十過後骨骼出現負增長，要保持骨骼健康有何妙法？戴祖儀為舒緩腰痛甘願雙腿受綁，效果令人意想不到，脊醫講解箇中道理，脊椎過直或過彎的舒緩方法大不同？細說倒立機如何達致放鬆腰部的功用。鄺潔楹、張秀文嘗試日本火熱的零位訓練，潔楹更在短短數分鐘增高3cm！原來只是錯覺？物理治療師拆解當中秘密，另告誡切勿亂用頸部牽引器舒緩頸痛。逆齡偵探到廣州體驗挪威引入的矯正療程，黃庭鋒、鄧佩儀慘被吊起，所為何事？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#12粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一與柏義合謀，成功從駿昇口中得知天龍失蹤原因。冠一趕往酒店，得悉正花已有抉擇，只好死心。正花與兆良談起未來的理想生活，突然提出閃婚。麗芬主動親近冠一，又告知正花決定閃婚。柏義與曦昕同困升降機內，曦昕承認惦念他，但不能原諒他太多瞞騙，難以復合。柏義認為正花閃婚，只是想冠一坦白真相，冠一有所決定……

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 潮江前輩與立花前輩一同實習，並在開始前擬定好計劃，立花在關口刻意被捕，再由假扮士兵的潮江救出。當立花即將成功之際，卻被新丁與喜三太發現，二人還以為立花大禍臨頭，欲協助他化險為夷……

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 蜂場負責人攜同養蜂箱作客「Kids’ Notes」，力求豐富大家對養蜂的相關知識。過往養蜂之法與現今有何不同？蜂箱內的蜜蜂分工明確，蜂后、工蜂各司其職，最高峰時期可容納三千隻蜜蜂，但當「蝸居」內的蜜蜂數量減少，為何卻要壓縮牠們的居住空間？原來與蜜蜂的健康有關。嘉賓還展示一些養蜂工具，也帶來沖蜜糖水的建議。據說蜜糖可長久保存不易變質，嘉賓提醒要視乎存放的環境，而香港天氣潮濕，宜放進雪櫃保存。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿驅加入阿渡的隊伍，一行人去到舉行儀式的地方，按照瑪蘿手上的食譜把七彩方塊烹調後，方塊竟然懂得開口說話，此時阿翔和麥格來襲，苦戰期間，龍神用問答方式幫助阿渡探索內心真正的願望。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 荃灣有樓齡近30年屋苑，單位大裝修後才發現樓上漏水，影響到浴室天花，窗戶防水膠也老化，怎樣解決？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 觀眾接獲來電，聲稱其牽涉與火災募捐相關的內地詐騙案，要求繳付保證金。觀眾機警識破騙局，並「報東張」希望公眾提高警覺。事主早前於內地受邀請參與黃金投資，對方聲稱會使用檢測儀在非洲勘探，更稱已獲當地政府批出黃金出口許可。事主遂以三十多萬向對方購買黃金，但付款後黃金一直未能交付，遂向對方追討，竟被遊說「加碼」投資……當局為宏福苑居民提供多方面支援，協助他們渡過火災難關。另帶來有助舒緩胃部不適的健康資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2699粵
programme.desc: Elaine為某商品設計宣傳海報，壯縱察覺不妥卻不忍批評。Elaine一時疏忽，將未通過的海報發佈至其社交平台，惹來網民劣評。璟風急向客戶補救，並於Elaine懇求下允許她修改海報。Elaine請Joe為新海報給予意見，Joe直接批評，並建議她再詢問壯的看法，她卻察覺壯不肯說老實話。另一方面，壯見Elaine近來與Joe親近，心生憂慮，其後得知真相，遂想挽回Elaine的信任，卻「撞大板」……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#21粵
programme.desc: 家妍深信雪君仍藏身香港，但詩晴為保全自身利益，決定抽身，二人不歡而散。肇華藉方太的負面傳聞發動突襲，企圖顛覆SNK權力格局。心碎的家妍拍片交代NovusVera事件，更做出令不少人震驚的抉擇。另邊廂，雪君給予慧心的資料，內藏驚人秘密，還觸及一場國際關係風波……方太為阻肇華吞併SNK，提出與慧心上契，將權力及股份轉讓，卻未能如願……肇華接連出招，對SNK來勢洶洶，慧心不再猶豫，決意要展開反擊……

programme.title: 去有風的地方#17粵普 及 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 明宇看中老宅作為書屋選址，紅豆的民宿也啟動工程，之遙幫忙安排師傅裝修。網店銷量大增，大家都忙不過來，村子又因網紅宣傳而遊客激增。之遙等人商量應對方法，決定動員村民幫忙，只有林娜心事重重，想請假卻被拒。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 阿姐的最佳旅伴登場，丈夫羅家英與她同遊不丹。首都廷布第一站前往「不丹彌敦道」觀光，阿姐瞥見有幸運彩票出售，即着家英哥「科金」購買。家英哥笑稱二人流落街頭坐在路旁，阿姐鬼馬提議他即興唱出乞討題材粵曲。繼續牽手逛街，他們找到一家香港市場，店裡可有香港特色？家英哥做足功課，帶阿姐到釋迦牟尼寺廟參觀並介紹相關資料，其後竟稱對牛彈琴？搜羅手信，家英哥提出為阿姐「埋單」卻被拒，更醒起零用錢都已交到對方手上……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#28粵PG
programme.desc: 卓凱發現斯敏失蹤，遍尋不獲。德信想留住嘉莉在自己身邊而欺騙她，並向她求婚，嘉莉猶豫。卓凱與道行無意中發現啟發年輕時的相片，找到重要線索。歡喜叮囑少鋒好好準備翌日對付德信的行動，少鋒有感自己有機會於復仇行動之中喪命，於是現身淑梅面前，帶她到主題公園遊玩，留下最美回憶後，少鋒黯然離去，淑梅不能阻止而憂心忡忡。歡喜計劃的暗殺行動失敗，少鋒還被長興眾人捉走毒打，德信要求天堂槍殺少鋒……

programme.title: 閨密教煮粵
programme.desc: 「大美人」李嘉欣被Jade的美食引誘而來，品嚐Jade悉心準備的「凱撒沙律」、「龍蝦意大利飯」、「藍莓士多啤梨蛋白酥」。嘉欣回憶參選港姐的點滴，談談事業與家庭，原來美人也有不為人知的出糗尷尬時！

programme.title: 娛樂大家粵
programme.desc: 跟薛家燕邊食邊傾，談起黯然銷魂飯，她立即扮失憶！家燕姐如此聰明，為何頭飾仍是那麼多？六號多次舉報成功，謝東閔單刀直入令人中招，值得一讚！蔡潔玩過後，才知眾人原來這麼奸險！「狼人」對陣，刺客出手第一晚，明明太醫救了皇帝，皇帝及後竟被劊子手陳煒所殺！遊戲經五晚才結束，最終是好人，還是壞人勝出？「真假話題」，家燕姐自稱曾遭串謀綁架，當時更驚到喊！姜皓文憶述年少時與母親聯手捉拿入屋的小偷，故事可有破綻？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻:環球新聞檔案粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
摩根大通特約:通悉牛熊粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 煎魚最怕黏鑊，容易燒焦之餘，賣相亦大打折扣！要減少魚腥味，又有甚麼要點？鼎爺傳授「豉汁煎封鯧魚」的竅門，還會講解鷹鯧與白鯧的分別。簡單的家常小炒，亦講求不少下廚技巧。鼎爺奉上香嫩可口的「雞絲炒粉絲」，炒合前更特意把粉絲放進雞湯浸軟，粉絲味道得以大大提升！鼎爺及後以巧手將原隻雞去骨並加入豐富配料，再把雞放入豬肚內，燉煮成一道功夫菜「悟能懷鳳胎」。阿譚急不及待品嚐鼎爺「手勢」，究竟有多滋味？

programme.title: 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 電競運動熱潮席捲全球！戴祖儀、曾展望、葉蒨文、林俊其、吳俊峰、曾文心、吳文懿等「電競星團」成員，聯同電競界知名評述「老星」主持的前奏節目《英雄召集：點解電競係電競》，會輕鬆有趣地分享相關知識與資訊，讓觀眾做好準備，迎接即將陸續上演的精彩電競賽事！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 免疫及過敏病科醫生指食物過敏主要受後天因素影響，更提到有研究發現如能盡早讓嬰兒接觸不同食物，引發過敏機會就較低。醫生述說八大致敏食物，又提醒小麥易被忽略，為甚麼？除了診治資訊，醫生還帶來應對過敏的保護策略。為推動傷健共融，著名舞蹈家成立團體「舞蹈天使」，讓不同殘障人士亦可感受舞蹈的魅力。創辦人到臨，分享學員習舞後的轉變，更難忘一次與學員在雨中共舞的演出。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅示範「咖哩燴牛脷」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 手機不離身的吳業坤近日「眼矇」兼「耳聾」，疑患耳目失靈症。眼科醫生細說手機所釋藍光對眼睛的影響；許文軒竟被驗出患上乾眼症！坤哥試戴日本大熱的視力眼罩來個小測試，神奇地一秒變「光明」？副社長麥美恩指導偵探們與坤哥做鬼臉式眼部瑜伽，皮膚科醫生還帶來雙眼保持緊緻的貼士。黃庭鋒到廣州親試採耳，並認識像音叉般的獨特工具。眾人又體驗悠久的「鳴天鼓」養生法，感覺如何？此外，中醫師另會教授可預防口臭的牙齦按摩法。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#13粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一想離開傷心地，向駿昇提出辭職。柏義被調往管理酒店，駿昇指此舉是保護曦昕，月華則認為他有可能破壞一對真心相愛的戀人。冠一收駿昇來電，邀他參與賭王與牌王對決，冠一最終助駿昇大勝。駿昇以高薪挽留他，冠一仍堅持離開。柏義決定向曦昕解釋清楚，修補兩人關係，卻遭冠一急電叫停，直指駿昇之前所說的全是謊言。柏義帶曦昕離家出走時，遇意外連人帶車墮海……

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 五年級生與六年級生的比試進入白熱階段，扮演被抓那方的小丸與新丁已相繼被擒，至於亂太郎則趁著混亂闖進後後山，希望能避開一眾來勢洶洶的前輩。這場後輩與前輩之戰，勝利將會花落誰家？

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」環節，在進行核心訓練中一個撐地並以膝蓋碰手肘的動作時，Tiffany姐姐因膝蓋未能觸碰手肘向教練求助，教練有何改善指導？稍作休息後，踏入平衡訓練時間。某個動作，學員撐地同時抬起左手與右腳，要保持平衡卻頗具挑戰。教練隨即建議改為同時抬起左手與左腳，但有學員反覺得更難掌握。另外，節目將帶來 AI生成動畫《林中小屋》的下半部，樵夫的三女在森林中會有何遭遇？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 今天是樂園學園的家長觀課日，陽葵的父母與妹妹陽彩全家到齊，還很早就來到校內參觀。就在這時，陽彩與趕上學的小學生遊真碰過正著，事後發現自己丟失了與美月同款的唇膏，令她整天都在愁眉苦臉。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港首間中醫醫院將於十二月中投入服務，新聞掏寶重溫1995年專題，當時政府尚未正式立法規管中藥和中醫註冊，市民看中醫有何保障？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵 及 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2700粵
programme.desc: 潮偉與某特務秘密聯絡，對方要求潮偉重出江湖，以對付一名危害特務組織的危險人物。已有多名特務因該人而非死即傷，為拯救眾人，潮偉無奈答應執行任務。另一邊廂，尚善發現不少蛛絲馬跡，懷疑潮偉有事隱瞞，更擔心他將不辭而別，暗中執行危險任務，遂決意設法挽留。城安知悉後，聯同熊家眾人出謀獻策，惟尚善否決眾人提議，打算自行解決此事，為此付出不少努力……潮偉藉詞出埠展開行動，尚善、城安暗中尾隨，怎料突生變故……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#22粵PG
programme.desc: 劉艷意外介入一宗虐兒案，由於錄影模糊，調查困難重重。另一邊廂，慧心積極拉攏SNK董事，與肇華的權力角力越加激烈。家妍忍不住出手，助劉艷調查虐兒案報道。劉艷揭露出社區保母的外判漏洞，惟因追訪時摔傷，意外被揭破隱瞞多時的秘密……慧心正面報道新式治療癌症儀器，芷瑤趁機在網台抹黑慧心與儀器持有人書昀，要妖魔化儀器。病人的命運，正隨着輿論風向而變幻莫測……

programme.title: 去有風的地方#18粵普 及 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 紅豆通過大麥得知林娜曾被網暴，林娜坦白因生日捐款風波所致，後來躲到雲南，現被認出仍心有餘悸，紅豆和大麥安慰陪伴。紅豆替林娜頂班，曉春收到騷擾短訊。曉夏關心林娜，林娜透露初到雲南時因曉夏等人幫助而留下。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 阿姐、家英哥探訪一位嫁往不丹的香港人妻，參觀其家居之餘，更獲招待當地特色菜餚。兩人還細聽這段異地婚姻的戀愛故事，相識僅三星期就步入共諧連理階段，香港新娘為了結婚還要考試？阿姐又與家英哥牽手漫步國家紀念佛塔，並繞塔祈福。家英哥與不丹國家隊成員合演足球友賽，阿姐手持啦啦隊彩球打氣，家英哥指名要聽<熱咖啡！賽後眾人到卡拉OK吧慶功，阿姐<華麗轉身展歌喉，家英哥更驚喜換裝向她高唱<Only You。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻:環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#29粵PG
programme.desc: 卓凱指少鋒遇險後無法聯絡天堂，淑梅往找天堂了解背後真相，卻見他喝得爛醉如泥。天堂向卓凱坦白事件，卓凱認定他沒有做錯。歡喜約見卓凱，交出雪晴的手機，希望助他揪出黑警勢力。德信與King商量洗黑錢事宜，天堂方知德信還有第二批錢，而歡喜亦找到合夥人洗黑錢。卓凱希望嘉莉幫忙尋找斯敏，嘉莉推敲出是德信所為，答應試探德信。歡喜拜祭亡妻，卓凱指已得知歡喜身份秘密，勸他收手，歡喜不以為然，聲言一定會竭盡全力復仇。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 煎魚最怕黏鑊，容易燒焦之餘，賣相亦大打折扣！要減少魚腥味，又有甚麼要點？鼎爺傳授「豉汁煎封鯧魚」的竅門，還會講解鷹鯧與白鯧的分別。簡單的家常小炒，亦講求不少下廚技巧。鼎爺奉上香嫩可口的「雞絲炒粉絲」，炒合前更特意把粉絲放進雞湯浸軟，粉絲味道得以大大提升！鼎爺及後以巧手將原隻雞去骨並加入豐富配料，再把雞放入豬肚內，燉煮成一道功夫菜「悟能懷鳳胎」。阿譚急不及待品嚐鼎爺「手勢」，究竟有多滋味？

programme.title: 閨密教煮粵
programme.desc: 鄭秀文為閨密跳入「食海」，拋開修身大計享用Jade精心炮製的「三文魚他他」、「紅酒汁慢煮牛扒」、「雲呢拿雪糕配車厘子汁」；席間細訴入行近三十年來的點滴，分享情緒病帶給她的人生體會。

programme.title: 關你家事粵
programme.desc: 54歲的Frankie原本從事建材生意，可惜後來與岳父因財失和，被對方伺機吞併生意，更因財困而與妻子交惡，面臨離婚關口。鬥志盡失的Frankie親臨節目，分享連串風波的來龍去脈。心理學家林玥彤、家庭治療師程翠雲提供心靈指導，助Frankie重整旗豉，修補夫妻溝通橋樑。主持看不過眼Frankie的頹喪形象，決定邀請造型師替他改頭換面，效果令人驚喜！藝人嘉賓單立文若與太太出現爭執，又會如何「拆彈」？

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 「鰽白魚骨裝飾製作技藝」、「木雕刻技藝」和「墓碑雕刻技藝」同名列於本港首份非物質文化遺產清單。民間工藝家馮啟仁，憑祖父的口頭傳述，摸索到如何把「魚骨變鳳凰」，他親身示範如何收集適合的魚骨作材料，逐一講解各個部件的形態，並示範如何砌成栩栩如生的雀鳥。神佛像工藝師王燮祥如何把一塊木頭製成一尊佛像？他的三位兒子對這份工作的前景有何看法？打石師傅蕭海波八十年代加入打石行列，他何以會選擇墓碑雕刻這門工作？

阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 外出選購陳村粉後，鼎爺坐鎮「煮場」炮製「花蟹雞油陳村粉」。陳村粉爽口彈牙之餘，還吸收了蟹肉的鮮味與雞油的芳香，讓過往不太愛吃陳村粉的阿譚另眼相看！其後，鼎爺採用京蔥、大頭菜等「重口味」配料醃雞，再以燜、焗方式，煮出皮脆肉嫩的「京蔥燒雞」。燜煮燒雞時，有甚麼需要注意？鼎爺得悉阿譚最近睡眠質素欠佳，貼心搜購牛蒡、腰果等健康食材，端上一道「寧神安睡湯」。他還會示範從蓮蓬取出蓮子，並去殼、去心的技巧。

programme.title: 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 電競運動熱潮席捲全球！戴祖儀、曾展望、葉蒨文、林俊其、吳俊峰、曾文心、吳文懿等「電競星團」成員，聯同電競界知名評述「老星」主持的前奏節目《英雄召集：點解電競係電競》，會輕鬆有趣地分享相關知識與資訊，讓觀眾做好準備，迎接即將陸續上演的精彩電競賽事！

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 能預防大腸瘜肉，就可大大減低患大腸癌風險，但如何做到？瘜肉無病徵，外科醫生提議可先進行大便隱血作初步測試，繼而接受大腸鏡檢查，並達致「一邊檢查，一邊切除」。有特殊學習需要的小朋友，一般難以表達自己，「表達藝術治療」提供一個非語言的表達途徑，讓孩子在過程中建立自信和自主性；表達藝術治療師以實例作示範，並細談令其印象深刻的個案。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie炮製一道新疆菜「大盤雞」，香辣惹味。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 不少都市人有腎虛毛病，腎氣強原來是抗衰老的靈丹，逆齡偵探遂前赴台灣尋訪補腎食材的不老良方！黑心水餃、黑麻麵可強腎，人氣美食蚵仔煎更有意想不到的營養成分？中醫師又怎看蚵仔補腎的說法？嘉賓艾粒兩子試做仰臥抬臀，飛燕點水動作，可有強腰效用？眾人猜猜不同水果、果汁的補腎功效，由營養師揭曉答案。許文軒、鄧佩儀到肇慶品嚐巴戟宴，對女士養生竟有莫大療效，惟要留意藥材服食劑量。面部皺紋分動態紋與靜態紋，如何區別？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#14粵PG
programme.desc: 林磊把罪證搶過來，令冠一受傷。駿昇在曦昕面前承認殺人，曦昕決定離家出走。冠一陪柔紫應診時碰見其西及正花，其西聲稱正花快將生兒育女，柔紫怕冠一傷心，出言安慰。曦昕認為柏義重視兄弟情多於愛情，柏義重申對她並無欺騙。有雜誌揭露冠一身世，正花得知後約見冠一，但冠一衷心祝福她與兆良，希望正花將他忘記。冠一獲余老闆賞識，猜測是由他向雜誌提供資料，以打擊駿昇，怎料背後策劃者竟是記者夏美詩……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 臨近寒假結束，小丸子跟同學在神社玩耍，卻被提醒忘了做新年寫大字功課。小丸子回家寫大字，多次寫錯令姐姐抱腹大笑，參考爺爺寫的大字亦不得要領。另一邊廂，花輪則讓家裡的員工代他寫大字。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 為朋友慶生，除了購買生日蛋糕，也可試試隨「Artspiration」插圖師的指引，繪畫生日蛋糕做禮物。三層高的蛋糕，忌廉、生果是不可缺少的元素，怎樣畫才夠像真？以不規則的線條畫出朱古力醬，再於蛋糕背後畫兩份禮物，更添心思！小朋友難免會有冒失的時候，輕便物品似乎霸佔了「被遺失物品排行榜」的頭幾名。尋回失物固然開心，但汲取教訓，想辦法於日後避免重覆犯錯，才是明智之舉，各位投稿的小朋友與主持們有何建議？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵等人寄宿的宿舍West Lily，與另一楝宿舍East Rose，將會展開一年一度的傳統活動，校舍清潔比賽。為贏得勝利，雙方都各出奇謀，同隊的愛里更出動父親公司的打掃法寶。然而，這些法寶卻撞倒松岡老師……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 逾1,000平方呎四房，容納一家三口，如何透過改動房門，修飾開則缺陷？訂造全屋家具時，怎樣才最划算？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2701粵
programme.desc: 尚善、城安得知潮偉參與任務的真相，事情亦遠超二人想像。雖然潮偉於意料之外的情況下「完成」任務，卻被要求接手另一項更艱巨的挑戰，並且必須付出某種犧牲。他本想推辭，卻因涉及某位重要人物而難以啓齒。對方給予潮偉七天時間考慮，潮偉將內心的掙扎向尚善傾訴，尚善竟反過來勸他接受任務。其後，潮偉遇上麻煩，尚善為他排難解困，希望他能安心執行任務，潮偉卻仍因某些顧慮而猶豫不決，尚善遂設法幫助他做出抉擇……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#23粵
programme.desc: 家妍帶領公開平台以報道反擊報道，將輿論壓力重新帶回書昀身上，到底要否回收治療癌症儀器，救病人一命，書昀必須做抉擇……慧心強勢回歸，登上SNK權力巔峰，肇華表面上指稱會退讓，暗中卻有所佈局。慧心於董事局會議，拋出震撼提議……家妍追查網上情騙案，劉艷調查大學生虧空公款案，兩宗報道看似風馬牛不相及，但線索竟然指向相同的關係網……志傲為了證明自己實力，願以身作餌，冒險潛入跨國詐騙據點「3U園」做調查報道。

programme.title: 去有風的地方#19粵普 及 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 有魚受曉春所託教小朋友唱歌，回來時聽到有人提到蔓君前男友，心頭一酸。林娜受眾人鼓勵，決定重開直播。四平夫婦到雲苗村探望之遙和紅豆，紅豆承諾會好好對之遙。鳳姨為謝強出獄一事擔憂不已，之遙勸她積極面對。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 家英哥偕阿姐登上海拔逾三千米的高地，挽手漫步參觀108 座佛塔名勝。聽到要挑戰不丹的國技射箭，家英哥自稱是「拿手好戲」。他與阿姐聯手對壘當地導遊，賽果如何？阿姐細心挑選兩人的不丹傳統喜慶服飾，竟換來差點被家英哥掌摑？他們換裝後於美景下開心留影，拍畢後，家英哥才告知阿姐這是婚照！二人接着更體驗不丹新婚夫婦的傳統習俗儀式，有僧侶為夫妻倆送上祝福，還有當地村民跟他們一同跳舞慶祝，場面洋溢幸福與喜悅。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻:環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#30粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)歡喜與德信各自進行對「烏茲爾國」的洗黑錢計劃，德信竟設計將歡喜的黑錢盡數偷去，歡喜因失去大批黑錢而陷入被國際黑錢客戶追殺的危機。德信以為贏盡歡喜，怎料黃雀在後，有人暗中將德信的黑錢偷走，令德信身陷險境。嘉莉被捉，德信被迫現身出手救人。德信尋回黑錢之時，歡喜忽然出現，卓凱亦同時趕到來，結果變成三雄持槍對峙局面……

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 外出選購陳村粉後，鼎爺坐鎮「煮場」炮製「花蟹雞油陳村粉」。陳村粉爽口彈牙之餘，還吸收了蟹肉的鮮味與雞油的芳香，讓過往不太愛吃陳村粉的阿譚另眼相看！其後，鼎爺採用京蔥、大頭菜等「重口味」配料醃雞，再以燜、焗方式，煮出皮脆肉嫩的「京蔥燒雞」。燜煮燒雞時，有甚麼需要注意？鼎爺得悉阿譚最近睡眠質素欠佳，貼心搜購牛蒡、腰果等健康食材，端上一道「寧神安睡湯」。他還會示範從蓮蓬取出蓮子，並去殼、去心的技巧。

programme.title: 閨密教煮粵
programme.desc: 方中信、袁偉豪、吳家樂品嚐Jade呈現的聖誕大餐「大蔥薯仔湯」、「聖誕烤火雞」、「鮮果撻」，聊聊令他們着迷的電單車，談談牽動他們神經的女子。為人父者還分享對子女拍拖的態度，此話題側田竟也有發言權？

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 芝士是邪惡美食之選，在佐敦，芝士食法多多，新主持譚玉瑛帶大家發掘，還有甚麼最邪惡推介？佐敦區抵食之選，隨時一蚊雞就可有一碟美食！陳自瑤介紹四家專一的餐廳，鯨吞法式三文治、廣東滷水、海膽及火鍋配料。

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林(完)
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了

programme.title: 喵咪漂浮歷險

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called "The Venoms", and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Three Sinners
programme.desc: Based on the classic Ming Dynasty novel The Water Margin, Three Sinners is a Huangmei Opera about love, betrayal, murder, and redemption. Starring Hong Kong's premiere movie couple, it is one of the grandest Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musicals in the Shaw Brothers library.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp;amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: Joey looks to start a new life after a failed suicide attempt but finds herself pregnant and dare not tell her ex-boyfriend. At the same time, she realizes that a mysterious woman is stalking her and begins to hallucinate, leading to a nervous breakdown. Taking advice from an abbot, Joey decides to uncover the truth in order to protect her baby...

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: Midnight Fly

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung; and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover Police Nick has spent 8 years working for the drug baron Quin, so as to collect evidence of his drug trafficking activities. After gaining Quin's trust, Nick becomes his protege and succeeds him as the drug baron when Quin retires. However, Nick has lost himself in his split life between trading drugs and searching for criminal evidence.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Mr Vampire

How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Cold Open
programme.desc: Tom and the riders discover the Ice Realm and find Buzzsaw inside.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Uncharted Territory
programme.desc: Alex and Eugene find themselves at odds with Tom and their fellow dragon riders when Feathers and Webmaster go missing during a blizzard in the Ice Realm.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Harmful Horrors of the Harrowing Hiveschool
programme.desc: After injecting all the teachers with bee DNA, the Melvins run the new "hivemind" of the school. But Ms. Ribble is accidently injected with too much "Bee- NA" and becomes the queen bee, overpowering the Melvins' control. George, Harold and the recently re-hired Vice Principal Krupp must work with the Melvins and stop her from turning everyone into her Zombees.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Preposterous Pulverizing of the Pestering Poopacabra
programme.desc: In hopes of raising their grades so they can go to Lake Summer Camp, George and Harold must teach Ratrick, their assigned rat, a simple task. But Ratrick runs away into the sewers where he is doused with toxic waste and transformed into Poopacabra! It's now up to the boys and Captain Underpants to stop the beast before it takes over Piqua with its stench, and more importantly, ruins the boys' chances to go to Lake Summer Camp.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Dastardlys Deed of the Devious Diddlysaurus
programme.desc: George and Harold decide to do an extra credit project on dinosaurs to help their chances of getting summer camp-worthy grades. When Melvin brings in a dinosaur frozen in ice, the boys try to get rid of it. But the ice thaws and they meet Diddlysaurus, a prankster raptor who's huge fans of the boys. He offers to help them with their project if he can pull pranks with them, but when the pranks go too far, the boys and Captain Underpants have to deal with the dino.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Turn And Burn
programme.desc: Stoick, Hiccup and Snotlout search for Spitelout when he goes missing, and ultimately find him on a distant island battling a fiery Singetail dragon.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Buffalord Soldier
programme.desc: Astrid comes down with the Odin's Revenge flu and the Riders must search for the cure by finding a nearly extinct Buffalord dragon before Viggo does.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Monsters & Mana
programme.desc: Allura and Lance walk in on Shiro, Pidge, Hunk, and Coran playing a magical role-playing board game

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Caverns And Creepers Rad Teacher
programme.desc: When Eep is kicked out of Thunk's new imaginary role-playing adventure game she decides to play her own, real version of the game; Fed up with Squawk's mean teaching style, Eep has Grug fire him and replace him with Rad, the quintessential young, cool teacher

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Dressage Sabotage
programme.desc: While Lucky and Spirit continue to explore a life in the circus, best friends Pru and Abigail set out to lasso in their friend back home. With new frontiers, new sights, and new friends the PALs ride free like never-before on wild circus adventures only to realize that there's no place like home.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Aquadons
programme.desc: To escape big trouble, the Dinotrux quickly put together a raft and hit the sea. But there might be danger lurking in the water, too.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Jungle Phone
programme.desc: When their jungle phone breaks Raa Raa and Ooo Ooo lose contact and Raa Raa thinks Ooo Ooo doesnt want to be friends any more. Luckily Topsy is able to help them find each other again.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Zippy Zipwire
programme.desc: Zebby is too scared to go down the zipwire and everyone chanting loudly at her makes matters worse. Raa Raa realises the noise is putting her off and if everyone is quiet it might help Zebby.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Noisy Story
programme.desc: Topsy wants to tell her friends her favourite story but they interrupt her making lots of noise. Topsy is upset. Raa Raa realises what has happened and goes to make amends.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Jingly Jangly Jungle Band
programme.desc: Raa Raa becomes the singer in Crockys Jingly Jangly Jungle Band but he gets so carried away with his singing that he forgets a promise.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Banana Balloons
programme.desc: Its Banana Day in the Jingly Jangly Jungle and Huffty gives everyone a banana balloon to play with but while Raa Raas friends are playing Banana Day games Raa Raa doesnt seem quite himself.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Crockys Lost Toy
programme.desc: When Raa Raa accidently loses Crockys favourite Toy hes determined to find it again and with a little help from his friends and by using his eyes and ears he does just that

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the "butt xylophone" couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse (a piece of it has been torn off). This must mean it’s time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many "lands" of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and The Vexing Villainy of the Vile Vimpire
programme.desc: When Erica makes fun of George and Harold’s latest and greatest comic, they make a comic about her becoming a vampire

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Cave New World
programme.desc: When the adults exclude the kids from their adult-only cave, the kids make their own much cooler cave, soon making the adults want to switch caves.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Dragons of the Undead
programme.desc: When Feather is taken by a group of what appear to be zombie dragons, Alex finds her inner hero and rescues her friend.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Chinese Nian Year Pt. 1
programme.desc: It’s Chinese New Year! With Yi and Jin tied up in their respective CNY festival performances, Peng and a semi-disguised Everest hit the festive streets, eating and enjoying everything in sight. Meanwhile, while paying respects to her late father at a temple, Yi panics when an accident breaks her magical violin strings. She hurries back to find her friends, only to spot Peng and Everest and watch them get snatched up by a menacing, mysterious creature!

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Bunker Break-InTo Catch a Critter
programme.desc: When Branch loses to Poppy at Capture the Flag, he challenges her to break into his bunker and steal Gary, to prove her abilities. Poppy organizes a whacky heist with the help of the Snack Pack. When Smidge accidentally loses some of the critters Milton cares for, she must try and retrieve them from Trolls Forest.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Stuff Campout
programme.desc: When Kelp and Scallop discover Mr. Pearly has a cave full of stuff they help him to realize it could help a lot of other sea creatures. When the group goes camping, Kelp helps Ollie learn that even though it didn’t go exactly as planned, they can still have loads of fun.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Family Trip Great Great Grandicorn
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop help Dad discover the true meaning of family trips. When the Great Great Grandicorn comes to visit, the kids learn that making mistakes is part of learning.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lost and Found In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Center's Lost and Found is full and it's up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Longest Yardwork The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Treasure Riders
programme.desc: When a swashbuckling adventurer named Waldondo comes to town, the Riders enthusiastically join him on a treasure hunt for a priceless gem.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Puff Enuf
programme.desc: The Riders find a Puffertail and train her to join the family. She struggles to learn but soon finds herself with a chance to make a big rescue.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Bees
programme.desc: Puss is terrified by an invasion by a swarm of bees, which only the hippy-like "Piper" can control with her magic flute.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Squad
programme.desc: Just as Puss is training the orphans to protect San Lorenzo, El Moco storms into town and cat-naps the swashbuckling hero.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Mister Mastodon
programme.desc: Po and team arrive in Guatemala and meet farmers who are facing a mysterious threat-- named The Protector, wielding the Storm Wheels. Elsewhere, Colin the Stag Knight and Weimin team up to go after Po and discover Mr. Ping's connection to the widely feared Pirate Queen.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - The Man In The Iron Booty
programme.desc: King Julien sends his entire kingdom away on rafts to help an alleged fellow king who is supposedly in distress.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Monkey Planet

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - We Meat Again
programme.desc: After their intense battle against Mr. Lung, the Creature Brigade disbands, leaving Yi and Everest as the remaining creature helpers. But thanks to an inert - but magical - chunk of meat called Taisui that falls from the sky, Yi finds herself caught in a time loop, forcing her to return the meat to its rightful home before sundown. Meanwhile, Jin and Peng end up on their own creature mission of sorts. Eventually the crew reunites, and together they are able to return Taisui and end the loop.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - A Hair-ifying Night
programme.desc: Our crew heads out of the city to reconnect with nature at a once-popular campsite, now deserted and in ruins owing to the urban legend of Yeren: a huge, hairy man who escaped from clown school as the tale goes. After some campfire spookiness, the crew comes face-to-face with the actual Yeren, who turns out to be a benevolent, camouflaging creature. The crew and Yeren team up to rejuvenate the campsite and keep it from being shut down.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Cat Cam
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a new camera that takes pictures with silly filters, CatRat uses it to lead Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats on a photographic scavenger hunt around the dollhouse!

programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes masks and capes for her and Pandy, they become the dollhouse defenders and must save the Gabby Cats from Bad Guy CatRat! In the Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song about her garden magic!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Mixed-Up Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a snow globe shaped like the dollhouse, she notices the rooms inside are all cattywampus and in the wrong place. After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Taxing Trauma of the Treacherous Tattle Trials Part I
programme.desc: In part one of a two-part season finale, the Melvins create a final exam that George and Harold will be sure to fail: the Doom Dome. To ensure success, Melvinborg injects Melvin's cells with nanobots, giving him heightened powers. But when George and Harold find out, they crank the nanobots to the max, causing Melvin to grow into a giant! The boys enlist Captain Underpants to fight the jealous nerd, but their victory only loses the nanobots onto Piqua...

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Taxing Trauma of the Treacherous Tattle Trials Part II
programme.desc: Part two of the season finale finds George, Harold, Captain Underpants, and the Melvins trapped in the Doom Dome with rampaging nanobots. When the humans try to neautralize the bots, they find a new host: Captain Underpants. Now they must shrink down to go into Captain Underpants’ brain and defeat the nanobots’ leader, Nanozero. But they need help: Captain Underpants’ brain cells to the rescue! And when it’s all over, George and Harold will finally be able to go to summer camp.

programme.desc: Harold and George can't wait to spend the summer together at camp. But not so fast, boys -- your old nemesis Mr. Krupp has a most unpleasant surprise.

programme.desc: The 2025 World Snooker Championship is a professional snooker tournament organised by the World Snooker Tour and will take place at the Crucible Theatre in Sheffield, England. programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP18
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP7
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP3
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP4
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP14
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP20

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP6
